1. ch4:5.8The covariant differential of the metric tensor is the zero tensor. Indeed, for all $X,Y,Z\in \mathcal{X}(M)$,

\[ abla G(X,Y,Z)=Z\langle X,Y angle -\langle abla _Z X,Y angle -\langle X, abla _Z Y angle =0, \]

because $ abla $ is the Riemannian connection. \end{example}
Proof

\sketch By section 4, $ abla G(X,Y,Z)=Z\langle X,Y angle -\langle abla _Z X,Y angle -\langle X, abla _Z Y angle $. Compatibility of the Levi-Civita connection with the metric (section def:dc-ch2-3-1) gives $Z\langle X,Y angle =\langle abla _Z X,Y angle +\langle X, abla _Z Y angle $, so the three terms cancel. $ lacksquare $
